reading_note: The teaching traces the progressive diminishment of the human reception of divine life across the successive churches. The "first generations" correspond to the Most Ancient Church, in which the love and wisdom of the Lord flowed unobstructed into the form of humanity (Adam) so that life-states were full and durable. The five governing powers (year, month, day, hour, moment) correspond to five discrete degrees of reception, descending from celestial to sensual; as humanity passes from being ruled by the highest degree to the lowest, "lifespan" — meaning the state of conjunction with the Divine — contracts. Today's many-from-one-womb offspring with feeble stature and evil counsel correspond to the proliferation of merely natural truths and affections, divided, weak, and mixed with falsity, when the interior light has withdrawn from the world.
